landing.heroDescription: EasyClip is a web clip library where you paste content into folders, then find it again with search and favorites.
landing.workflowTitle: Save it, find it, and use it again.
landing.workflowDescription: Paste content into the folder you are working in, organize it, then search and copy it whenever you need it.
